## Citizen problem and change

Describe the problem and the smallest change that addresses it.

## Evidence and boundaries

For guidance or rule changes, link the primary source and note its date, jurisdiction and limitations. Explain any change to data handling.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify` passed, or failures are explained below.
- [ ] English and Hindi are covered.
- [ ] Regression tests cover the changed behavior and its failure path.
- [ ] No credentials, real citizen records or generated build output are included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.

List any checks not run or limitations reviewers should know about.
